summary.zh-CN: 在运行 Teloa 的电脑上将语音转成输入框文字；支持中文、粤语、英语、日语和韩语。
summary.en: Turn speech into composer text on the computer running Teloa. Supports Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese and Korean.

license.name: FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement

restrictions.zh-CN: 模型权重遵循 FunASR 模型许可；源码 MIT 许可不替代权重许可，使用和再分发须保留所要求的声明。
restrictions.en: Weights follow the FunASR model license. The source-code MIT license does not replace the weight license; retain the required notices when using or redistributing the model.

notes.zh-CN: 由 DSH 原生语音扩展准备和管理；使用 SenseVoiceSmall ONNX 与 Silero VAD。
notes.en: Prepared and managed by the native DSH speech extension using SenseVoiceSmall ONNX and Silero VAD.

notes.zh-CN: 默认 INT8 主权重约 239 MB，另有词表和 VAD；文件体积不代表运行内存。具体版本、摘要和下载进度由原生准备器核对。
notes.en: The default INT8 main weight is about 239 MB, plus tokens and VAD. File size is not runtime memory; the native preparer verifies versions, hashes and download progress.

notes.zh-CN: 安装位置是运行 Teloa 的电脑，不是打开网页的设备。首次准备需要下载；就绪后本地识别。停用扩展保留缓存。
notes.en: Installation is on the computer that runs Teloa, not the device viewing this page. Initial preparation requires a download; recognition then runs locally. Disabling the extension retains cached files.

conditions.zh-CN: 先启用原生「语音输入」扩展并重启 Teloa，再确认准备。原生支持目标含 macOS arm64/x64、Linux glibc arm64/x64、Windows x64；实际就绪状态以 Teloa 的检查为准。
conditions.en: Enable the native Voice Input extension, restart Teloa, then confirm preparation. Native targets include macOS arm64/x64, Linux glibc arm64/x64 and Windows x64; actual readiness is determined by Teloa's check.
